All objectives completed. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Ticket created: ref **RD-1015**, title **"scref1 RD Bench Ticket"**, customer "Bench Customer", initial status **Draft**. (Only Title was required; Customer optional.)

**2. DONE** — Part **"scref1 RD Part A"** added with cost **$100.00**, markup **25%**. App-computed price: **$125.00** (100 + 25%).

**3. DONE** — Part **"scref1 RD Part B"** added with cost **$200.00**, markup **25%**. App-computed price: **$250.00** (200 + 25%). Parts total at that point: $375.00.

**4. DONE** — Part A's cost changed from 100 to **150** (markup still 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (150 + 25%). Parts total became $437.50.

**5. DONE** — Ticket ends in status **Ready**. Precondition discovered: clicking "Mark Ready" while parts had no supplier produced the alert: *"Ticket is not ready — Part "scref1 RD Part A" has no supplier — Part "scref1 RD Part B" has no supplier"*. What was required: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier assigned**. I set supplier "Acme Supply" on both parts (values otherwise unchanged: A = $150/25% → $187.50, B = $200/25% → $250.00), after which "Mark Ready" succeeded and the status showed **Ready** (button flipped to "Mark Draft"/"Mark Closed").

**6. DONE** — Both parts deleted (parts table shows "No parts on this ticket yet.", parts count **0**), and the ticket archived (detail page shows "Archived" badge and an "Unarchive ticket" button; archive required no additional precondition). Verified in the tickets list: with "Show archived" unchecked, RD-1015 does not appear among the 13 active tickets; with it checked, RD-1015 appears as **Archived | Ready | Parts 0**. Nothing created by this run remains active.
